about: Start one subagent to read notes.md and docs/plan.md and report which day the release ships and when the branch freezes. Don't read the files yourself; answer with what it reports. A subagent that reads two files and reports back, whose own calls are its progress while it runs, then the answer from its report.

known.line: tool #1 agent run_subagent {"profile":"subagent_explore","task":"Read notes.md and docs/plan.md, then report which day the release ships and when the branch freezes.","title":"Read the release notes"} -> Subagent completed:\nThe release ships on Friday, and the branch freezes on Friday.
known.reason: Devin 3000.11.205 replays a finished call on session/load as the call and a bare `completed` update, without the result it sent live. A question's picks and a quiet command's exit come back from the update's `_meta` (`DEVIN_ACP_HOOKS.restated`); nothing in a read's update says how many lines it showed. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the result.
